title: Cross-org sprint synthesis — Oct 06 2026
body:
Purpose: quick synth of the engineering all-hands + cross-org sync for the week ending 2026-10-06. Put together fast — this is a working capture. Use for follow-ups and the hand-off list for next week.

High-level TL;DR:
- Shipping: KV-cache tuning landed to prod canary; preliminary numbers show 8–12% tail latency improvement on 16k sequence workflows.
- Incident: 15m degradation in us-west1 autoscaler (JIRA-2987) during peak — root cause traced to kube-controller race when scaling replicaSets with mixed GPU types.
- Rollouts: canary for new quantized-mmap builds paused for mobile SDK client fix (see PR 876).
- Cross-team ask: infra + release-eng, need 2-day window next sprint to run capacity rebalancing tests (plan below).

Agenda from the all-hands (notes + deviations):
1) Opening (5m): short state of latency/cost targets.
2) Wins (10m): runtime optimizations, internal eval pass rate improvements.
3) Incidents & learnings (10m): us-west1 autoscaler event + mitigation.
4) Rollouts & canaries (10m): status of quantized builds, SDK rollout hold.
5) Ask & dependencies (10m): resource windows, security sign-offs.
6) Q&A (rest): notes captured.

Wins / Recent progress:
- KV cache: Marcus’s patch (kv-cache: adaptive-prefix-window) applied to canary fleet on 2026-10-04. Observed: median token generation latency unchanged, p95 down ~6–8% for seq_len > 8k, p99 down ~12% in synthetic heavy-prefix tests. Next: extend to dedicated pools after rollback window.
- Model routing: short-circuit path for small payloads (<=512 tokens) reduced scheduler overhead by ~4% overall. Customer-facing impact: lower cold-start jitter.
- Observability: per-route token-cost telemetry now surfaces in console (beta feature in prod for 5% of tenants). Early feedback from 2 pilot customers is positive.

Incidents and mitigations (short-form):
- JIRA-2987 (2026-10-05 14:23 UTC): autoscaler thrash in us-west1 during a sustained spike. Impact: increased queuing and ~15m of elevated tail latency for hosted API.
  - Root cause: kube-controller interactions when HPA scaled nodes that had mixed GPU types and z-node labels; autoscaler controller loop failed to honour the pod anti-affinity for GPU_profile=v3.
  - Short-term mitigation: tightened anti-affinity matching and drained mis-provisioned nodes; rollbacks to previous autoscaler version performed at 14:40 UTC.
  - Longer-term: release-eng + infra to implement a deterministic node-selection patch and e2e test covering mixed GPU pools (owner: Samir, due 2026-10-14).

Rollouts & releases:
- Quantized mmap builds (tag: q-mmap-v2): scheduled canary 2026-09-30; paused 2026-10-05 after SDK incompatibility surfaced in mobile clients.
  - Action: mobile SDK team to ship compat-fix (PR 876) then restart canary on smaller traffic slice.
- Dedicated capacity autoscale policy v0.9: rolling out to 20% of Dedicated accounts this week. Watch: burst failures when combined with caching TTL=0 configs — noted two customer fallbacks; engineering to add guardrail to TTL settings.

Cross-team asks / dependencies:
- Infra / Release-eng: need two full days of quiet window for capacity rebalancing tests (non-prod), proposed 2026-10-19 and 2026-10-20. Purpose: validate node allocation changes and deterministic evictions. Owner: Samir.
- Security: sign-off required on S3 key rotation plan before private-deployments rollout resumes (ticket JIRA-3021). Target: 2026-10-13. Owner: Anya.
- Developer Experience: finalize SDK compatibility matrix and ship deprecation notice for v0.8 endpoints. Owner: Marcus, target 2026-10-11.

Notes from team updates (micro-standups captured during QA):
- Serving-runtime: Diego
  - Finished low-level kernel selection heuristic for attention with group-size 4. Perf looks promising on A100-80GB; needs more perf runs on H100.
  - TODO: automated perf suite to add H100 runs (ticket: PERF-451).
- Observability: Anya
  - Console per-route billing view beta enabled; want more feedback from platform teams on sampling ratios.
  - Shifting retention policy to 14 days for debug traces (pilot) to reduce cost.
- Platform-engineering: Marcus
  - Node lab environment extended with mixed GPU pools (v3). Found scheduling anomalies reproduced locally.
  - Next: test deterministic node-selection patch.

Decisions made in meeting:
- Pause wide rollout of q-mmap-v2 until mobile SDK compat-fix lands. (Rationale: avoid broad customer impact; cheaper to pause than chase multiple rollbacks.)
- Proceed with KV-cache extension to Dedicated after canary stability window passes (48h observation).
- Approve the 2-day capacity rebalancing window (2026-10-19/20) — infra to publish runbook.

Open questions / unresolved:
- How aggressive should cache TTL be for Dedicated accounts with bursty traffic? Need empirical guidance and possibly per-account guardrails. (Action: product + platform to propose ranges by 2026-10-12.)
- Can we automate SDK compatibility checks into CI for every runtime PR? (Engineering infra to estimate effort; owner: Diego; due 2026-10-15.)

Action items (owners + target dates):
- Samir: deterministic node-selection patch + e2e for mixed GPU pools — 2026-10-14.
- Marcus: SDK compatibility matrix doc + deprecation notice draft — 2026-10-11.
- Anya: Security sign-off coordination for S3 key rotation (JIRA-3021) — 2026-10-13.
- Diego: add H100 runs to automated perf suite (PERF-451) — 2026-10-18.
- Product: propose cache TTL guardrails for Dedicated — 2026-10-12.

Quick wins / low-risk follow-ups (can be done without cross-org windows):
- Increase sampling on per-route billing for pilot tenants to gather more signals (obs: small config flip). Owner: Anya.
- Add a lightweight CI job to run mobile SDK smoke against q-mmap artifacts (pre-merge). Owner: Marcus.

Appendix / scratch notes (raw, unpolished):
- Customer chatter: 2 feature requests about token-cost visibility -> route-level gamma. Need product thread.
- "Notes to self" for release playbook: add explicit rollback step for mixed-GPU nodes.
- Slack refs: #infra-ops (thread: autoscaler-10-05), #platform-announcements (kv-cache roll).

Next all-hands: tentative 2026-10-13 (one week cadence) — propose a focused deep-dive on quantization tradeoffs + customer-impact case studies.

If you want edits/add structure for Confluence, flag me (Lena) — I’ll convert and link PRs.

-- end of notes --
